dialogue.t: Greetings, Honorary Knight! Greetings, Paimon! My name is Freda. I'm a knight from the Logistics Company. It's such an honor to meet the famous {NICKNAME} and his(her) loyal attendant!
I'll provide new supplies regularly. Feel free to come check them out whenever you've got some time.
You're in luck! I just got a new batch of provisions! Please take a look and see if anything catches your eye!
